mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing armodafinil plasma concentrations and CNS effects; both drugs have stimulant properties that may potentiate CNS excitation.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS stimulation, insomnia, or agitation; consider dose reduction of armodafinil if adverse effects emerge; baseline and periodic liver function tests are recommended as both drugs have hepatotoxic potential.
